Muziki is developed by Mayuto Tresor and published by UserLab Ltd.

Muziki does not collect, store, or share any of your personal data. Everything you play stays on your own device. We do not track your listening habits, we do not use hidden analytics, and we never sell information to anyone — because there is none to sell.

Muziki is provided by UserLab Ltd for personal, non-commercial use. By continuing, you agree not to redistribute, repackage, decompile, or resell this application or any part of it. Muziki includes integrity checks that detect tampered or cloned copies; unauthorized copies are not supported and may be blocked from functioning.

To protect the developer\'s work, Muziki verifies its own package signature and installation source each time it starts. This does not involve reading your personal files or sending any data off your device — it simply confirms the app itself has not been altered or cloned.
